title: fix(plugin-auth): every rule that reads an SSO provider's domain list reads each entry the same way
body:
security#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cx5nHfga3Hm9BzikGw

Filed by the security lane as a follow-up from the contract review of #32669 (record 6839407007, escalation c). Priority and lane are triage's.

Blocked-by: #32669

## Why

Three rules read an SSO provider's `domain` list: the one-provider-per-domain claim rule (`sso-provider-lifecycle.ts`, `providerDomains`), the proven-domain account rule #32669 adds, and the SCIM adoption rule (`scim-sso-adoption.ts`, its domain condition). The first two read each entry as a host in one spelling; the SCIM rule splits on commas, trims, lower-cases and compares raw text. So one stored entry can name a domain under one rule and not under another.

## Rule

Every rule that reads a provider's domain list reads each entry through the same parse, so an entry names the same domain everywhere it is judged.

## Acceptance

- The SCIM adoption rule reads the list through the shared parse; an entry that the shared parse does not accept names no domain for SCIM either.
- Tests named by the rule: one entry spelling judged identically by the claim rule, the account rule and the SCIM rule; a control for a bare hostname.
